The same is already true of «بازار» in the approved crumb «بازار اور تفریح گاہیں»: a masculine noun ending in a consonant has no distinct direct plural in Urdu, and context gives the number. Press usage (urdunews.com/tags/پارک, HTTP 200): «120 پارکوں کی تزئین و آرائش», «پارکوں اور تفریحی مقامات کا رخ» — and also «سرسبز پارکس» / «300 سے زائد پارکس»: the press writes the English plural, which the owner's decision bars («پارکس» never); recorded for search only. On the same page the menu label above the crumb and «تمام» on the back link carry the plural. ‖ STAGE 7: read in place on national-park (blind-input.on-05 lines 404 and 447). The reader quotes both and does not read a singular; his remark (item 33, moderate) is that the crumb names the section otherwise than the menu — the source's two names, logged as a source defect.
